title: Example: switch weapons with the mouse wheel
summary: A second revision of the example plan, as if new commits came in after the first one. The newer commits make the wheel wrap around: scrolling past the last weapon goes back to the first. As before, scrolling up picks the next weapon and scrolling down the previous one, and the **1** and **2** keys still pick a weapon directly.

setup.title: Open the game
setup.body: Open the link above in a desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari). The first load takes a moment.

setup.title: Capture the mouse
setup.body: Click inside the game. The pointer disappears and moving the mouse turns your view. Press **Esc** whenever you want the pointer back.

setup.title: Find the weapon name
setup.body: The text over the game shows your health, then the weapon you're holding, such as **Pistol**. The tests below check that name.

sections.title: Switching with the wheel
sections.intro: These tests check the new mouse wheel switching.

setup.title: Use a mouse with a scroll wheel
setup.body: These tests need a mouse wheel. A laptop trackpad's two-finger scroll works too, but one notch of a wheel is easier to count. Without either, mark these tests **Skip**.

tests.title: Scrolling up switches to the next weapon
tests.why: This is the main change in the pull request.
steps: Scroll the mouse wheel up one notch.
expected: The weapon name changes from **Pistol** to **Shotgun**.

tests.title: Scrolling up past the last weapon wraps around
tests.before: You need the shotgun from the previous test.
steps: Scroll the mouse wheel up one more notch.
expected: The weapon name changes from **Shotgun** back to **Pistol**.

tests.title: Scrolling down switches to the previous weapon
tests.before: You need the pistol from the previous test.
steps: Scroll the mouse wheel down one notch.
expected: The weapon name changes from **Pistol** to **Shotgun**, wrapping around the other way.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed

tests.title: The number keys still switch weapons
tests.before: You need the shotgun from the previous test.
expected: The weapon name changes to **Pistol** after you press 1, and back to **Shotgun** after you press 2.

notCovered: How far a trackpad has to scroll to count as one step. That's covered by automated tests.
